scope: Owner-local immediate upright lateral danger action; not whole-LAMBS parity
sourceIntent: Immediate native dodge after a hit: prone stationary roll under open overhead space; otherwise stance drop and direction/distance-dependent native Fast/Tact actions. Forced gesture helper uses playActionNow. Source also emits optional voice callouts.
finding: CBE implements prone native evasion and finite weak posture, but not the source upright action. Protecting committed/native movement does not supply a short reaction for idle upright riflemen.
implementation: Existing DangerEngineAct IMMEDIATE hit/near-round branch now additionally admits idle STAND/CROUCH primary-weapon actors under the existing feature, task, medical, external, MOVE/PATH, route/reservation and three-second cooldown rules. Choose TactL/TactR away from the observed danger side, random only without a useful bearing. Two ASL side segments at lower-body/eye height over two metres veto known obstructions; a blocked side retains posture without alternate movement. Spend cooldown before probes, including refusal. Actual native action retains mobile crouch rather than immediate hard-cover prone. No destination, new movement lease, handler, worker or timer.
departures: No fast, forward or backward rush added; source random callout not imported.
Native action remains engine-driven; segments do not establish swept human-body clearance, safe footing, animation range or tactical success.
cost: At most two short-circuited geometry casts per eligible upright probe under the existing three-second actor cooldown. No world/roster scan. Runtime cost and balance unmeasured.
provenance: Unsigned dirty development snapshot based on4424b4d3 plus implementation and unrelated pre-existing dirt. Private review and handover postdate package. Initial successful build preceded the setting wording update; final build named here covers it.
